signed_in.title: You're signed in
signed_in.next: Go back to Oleafly to keep going. You can close this tab.
refused.title: Not allowed on {server}
refused.heading: {server} didn't let you in
refused.email_account: You signed in with {account}, and that address isn't on this server's list.
refused.email: That email address isn't on this server's list.
refused.email_next: Ask the server's admin to add it, or start again in Oleafly with an address they added.
refused.provider_account: You signed in to {provider} as {account}, and that account isn't on this server's list.
refused.provider: Your {provider} account isn't on this server's list.
refused.provider_next: Ask the server's admin to add you. To use a different account, sign out of {provider} in this browser, then try again in Oleafly.
cancelled.title: Sign-in cancelled
cancelled.body: You didn't let {server} use your {provider} account.
cancelled.next: Go back to Oleafly if you want to try again.
setup_code.title: The setup code didn't work
setup_code.body: It's wrong, or someone already used it.
setup_code.next: Copy the newest Setup code line from the server's log, then try again in Oleafly.
provider_failed.heading: {provider} didn't finish signing you in
provider_failed.body: The sign-in stopped before {server} heard back from {provider}.
provider_failed.next: Go back to Oleafly and try again. If it keeps happening, tell the server's admin.
expired.title: This sign-in expired
expired.body: It took too long, or it was already used.
start_again: Go back to Oleafly and start signing in again.
device_in_use.title: Linked to another account
device_in_use.heading: This computer is linked to another account
device_in_use.body: {server} has this computer on another person's account.
device_in_use.next: Go back to Oleafly and sign in again. Your next try sets this computer up for you.
option_off.title: This sign-in option is off
option_off.next: Go back to Oleafly and choose another way to sign in.
unfinished.title: Sign-in didn't finish
unfinished.body: {server} stopped the sign-in before it was done.
unfinished.next: Go back to Oleafly and try again.
out_of_date.title: This sign-in is out of date
out_of_date.body: This page belongs to an earlier sign-in.
elsewhere.title: Oleafly sign-in
elsewhere.heading: Nothing to show here
elsewhere.body: Oleafly uses this address only while you sign in to a collaboration server.
